choices.text: Góc giữa hai mặt phẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> và <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> là <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>O</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">̂</mo></mover></semantics></math>

<math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math> vuông góc với mặt phẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math>

Thể tích khối hộp chữ nhật <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi><mi>.</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>D</mi><mi>′</mi></mrow></semantics></math> bằng sáu lần thể tích khối chóp <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>′</mi><mi>.</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math>
